title: Trace each sync run through the logs
description:
When a run goes wrong we currently get one line, `sync failed`, and have to reconstruct the rest from the warehouse's audit table. This gives every run a trace id, carried on each log line the run writes, and adds debug lines at the points we keep wishing we could see: how many levels were loaded, which rows were unknown, how many batches were applied, and each fetch attempt.

`LOG_LEVEL` picks the threshold (default `info`, so none of the new debug lines show unless asked for). While in there: a level the warehouse reports as negative is now skipped and warned about rather than adjusted, since the two we have seen were both audit-table corruption and adjusting them made it worse.

commit.subject: Trace each sync run through the logs
commit.body:
A trace id per run on every line, debug lines at the points we keep
needing, LOG_LEVEL to turn them on. A negative warehouse level is skipped
and warned about instead of adjusted.
